initial_failure: Killing an offline screening process left no sample evidence because the report was written only after all repetitions finished.
fix: Exclusively create a JSONL journal; flush and fsync screen metadata, each sample start and each outcome. Emit overall completion only after the screen finishes. Refuse reuse when either journal or report already exists. CI always uploads both files.
crash_drill: Owned subprocess is SIGKILLed after finishing its warm-up and starting repetition 1. Journal retains one completed sample plus the unfinished sample identity; final report is absent. A fresh invocation against the same evidence path refuses without modifying the journal.
verification: All 62 start/finish pairs match the completed report exactly. Injected failure/timeout outcomes remain in the recorder. Ruff, formatting, diff and workflow YAML checks pass; hosted CI not run.
limits: Offline benchmark evidence durability under process termination, not recovery of production approvals or external actions. This is not a power-loss drill, provider-latency comparison or runtime qualification. No deployment.
